deductions.method: sxv's: a finite sum split at its last term; pop of all 64 bits is 64; pop(2^r - 1) = r (the counter and popcount algebra is the allocator study's sxv (stxlib_notes, planning/stx_minmallocpp/SXV_EVALUATION.md, 2026-11-18), re-implemented here; sxv stays study-only (owner, IC decision 6))
premises: the plan's words are the capacity in 64-bit words, rounded up, so every word but the last is full (remaining >= 64) and the last holds 1 to 64 blocks
a word with remaining >= 64 is u64_max, the last 2^remaining - 1 (or u64_max when remaining is 64)
steps: from words >= 1; remaining == capacity - 64 * (words - 1); remaining >= 1; remaining <= 64; sum == 64 * (words - 1) + pop(2^remaining - 1); live == 0
